## Objective

No row without its object after any interruption.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Interruptions at each step leave either nothing or an orphan object that reconciliation removes
- [ ] An interrupted ingest resumes or rolls back without duplicate effects, and start-up reconciles pending operations

## Test requirements

Fault-injection tests.
